newsitem.title: JAPAN: Restitution talks delay Japan reactor construction.
newsitem.headline: Restitution talks delay Japan reactor construction.

text.p: The Electric Power Development Co Ltd said on Wednesday it would postpone construction of a nuclear power plant in northern Japan by one and a half years due to prolonged compensation talks with local fishermen.

The semi-governmental power producer originally planned to start building a 1.38 million kilowatt reactor at Oma on the northern tip of Japan's main island in September 1999, and to bring the plant on line in March 2005.
However, the power producer was forced to reconsider the original plan amid protracted negotiations with local fishermen's unions on compensation.
Under the new plan, construction is due to start in April 2001 and commercial operations are scheduled to begin in October 2006.
